## The question

The maintainer's ruling `6335348115` on #25082 (F2 B3, 「同意」) retires `renderTemplate` (`@objectstack/plugin-email`) and `renderNotification` (`@objectstack/service-messaging`) under ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired`, BREAKING, at once. The card thread built it and the gate split the pair:

- `@objectstack/service-messaging#renderNotification` **verifies**: `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` exits 0 on the branch head `ac294b00` (re-run by this thread against `origin/main` `cc8d886`: exit 0, "verified: @objectstack/service-messaging#renderNotification (export, packages/services/service-messaging/src/template-renderer.ts)").
- `@objectstack/plugin-email#renderTemplate` **cannot be verified**: on `85058b6e` (both retired) the same command exits 1 with "[predicate 2: no-metadata-surface] is false: packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts (a spec contracts/** entry) mentions `renderTemplate` IN CODE while neither declaring nor importing it" and quotes the method signature line (re-run by this thread: exit 1, same line). The hit is `IEmailService.renderTemplate`, a METHOD SIGNATURE of the same name on the spec contract (`email-service.ts:338`): the gate's homonym test `declaresLocally` reads only top-level declarations (`interface|type|class|enum|const|let|var|function NAME`), so a member declaration falls through to "an unresolvable mention", and the gate refuses an unresolvable mention by design. The gate is `domain:spec` tooling (the lane table's anchoring exception); this project owns `cli`, `services` and `ui` only and does not edit it.

Forks as the card put them: **A** land `renderNotification` now, the spec lane teaches the homonym test that a same-named member declaration is a homonym, `renderTemplate` lands as a second PR on this card once that holds; **B** hold the whole card until then; **C** retire `renderTemplate` now under `no-migration-prescription` with an arrowless FROM/TO line; **D** write an ADR-0087 ledger entry for it in `packages/spec`.

## Governing text, read at `origin/main` `cc8d886`

- Ruling `6335348115` item 6: 「one card retiring the two exports that take a template body with no save moment … under ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired`, BREAKING, at once — no staged window」; 「Whether `interpolate` goes with them is that card's first measurement」.
- ADR-0087 D9, predicate 2 as the ADR words it: 「**no-metadata-surface** — at the merge base, no operand is declared in a `*.zod.ts`, under `packages/spec/src/contracts/` or in an object definition, none is a Zod projection, and no metadata surface **references** it in code」. Its "Not taken": 「**Exports only** — a mixed retirement would keep its member half on the catch-all, held by a detector miss: the shape D7 retires」; the worked example 「stays on `no-migration-prescription`. **New retirements use this category**」; and its channel argument: 「the ledger has no metadata to rewrite」.
- `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`, header: 「Unresolvable, so refused rather than assumed unrelated (#4690)」; the `PackagePublishResult` pair is the gate's own accept/refuse fixture for a same NAME under two paths; and its own precedent for a reader fix that admits more: 「a file whose only import of the symbol is commented out used to be refused as an IMPORT and is now not a reference at all (a loosening — a commented-out import puts nothing in a schema)」. `metadataSurfaceKind`: a `*.test.ts` under `contracts/` is not a surface (self-test U5), so the method signature is the ONLY code hit for `renderTemplate` on any metadata surface at the base (the other two mentions in that file and the one in `notification-template.object.ts` are docblocks, masked).
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈升级与决策〉, the named non-escalation classes: 「技术任务间顺序与依赖;验证策略」 and 「既有门禁内部参数与盲区修复」; 〈状态机〉 `references/state-machine.md`: 「工已完而被门禁缺陷卡住者同用本态,⛔ 不设新标签、不重派;`Blocked-by:` 指向门禁卡」.
- This project's standing rule from its owner: lanes `spec` / `engine` / `skills` belong to another account's project — this project files no card there and edits nothing there; it leaves a comment for that lane's seat.

## Ruling: A

**Why not C.** D9 names the arrowless line held by a detector miss as 「the shape D7 retires」 and says new retirements use `runtime-export-retired`. C would also put the honest category on one half and a detector miss on the other for the same ruling — the mixed shape D9's "Not taken" exists to refuse.

**Why not D.** A retired runtime export is compiler-carried (D9): `objectstack migrate meta`, `spec-changes.json` and the upgrade guide would project an entry that rewrites nothing — false data in the one ledger this gate keeps true. It is also a `packages/spec` write from the wrong lane.

**Why not B.** The ruled disposition is 「at once — no staged window」. B holds a verified retirement behind a gate fix in a lane this project cannot schedule, with no date; nothing in the text asks the two halves to land in one PR, and the card already carries them as two operands.

**Why A is inside the text, and self-rulable.** The retirement itself is the maintainer's ruling; what is open is sequencing between two operands and a verification route — the named non-escalation class 「技术任务间顺序与依赖;验证策略」. A lands the verifiable half at once under the ruled category, keeps the ruled category for the other half, and asks the gate's owner for exactly what the gate's own refusal text asks for (a disposition that can be checked). No floor moves: no security or permission boundary, no published contract sentence, no product trade-off beyond the one already ruled, and this ruling changes no gate — the gate's correction is the spec lane's to judge and land (a blind-spot fix of an existing gate's reader, the class its header already records once). Failure is loud and reverts once: if the spec lane rules otherwise, the `renderTemplate` half comes back to the box as a fresh fork (item 4 below).

Fixed here, so the dev opens no second decision:

1. **PR 1 — `renderNotification`.** The branch `claude/project-thread-gru6pg` at `ac294b00` is the shape: `@objectstack/service-messaging` only, one `patch` changeset with the BREAKING banner, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, marker `not-required (runtime-export-retired @objectstack/service-messaging#renderNotification)`, FROM line spelled with the bare export name (the `85058b6e` predicate-3 refusal was the "imported from" suffix on the FROM operand; `ac294b00`'s spelling is the one to keep). 2. **`interpolate` stays.** Ruling item 6 made it the card's first measurement, and the measurement decides: it renders the plain-text faces (subject, text, markdown), which the placement rule judges at no door, and R2 of `6334219164` named only the two html body-taking doors. Independently, its retirement is unverifiable today for the same predicate-2 reason (`io-node-config.zod.ts` names the English word in an error-message string, and string literals are unmasked on purpose). The claim's line "it goes with them" is superseded by the report; the changeset's "Unchanged: `interpolate`" line is right.
3. **Hand-off to the spec lane — a comment, not a card from this project.** The card thread posts ONE pointer comment on the `domain:spec` seat post (#18549) carrying the out-of-scope finding as the report classifies it (class b · the ruled disposition for `@objectstack/plugin-email#renderTemplate` · Seam: `spec:contracts/email-service.ts` `IEmailService.renderTemplate` → `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` `metadataSurfaceReference` / `declaresLocally` · dedupe words: adr-0087 homonym member signature, runtime-export-retired predicate 2, no-metadata-surface method name) and this comment's id. What it asks that lane to judge: whether a same-named member declaration (a method or property signature inside an interface, class or type literal) is a homonym like a top-level declaration, with a self-test case each way (a member DECLARATION clears; a bare call or mention in code still refuses; string literals unchanged). Filing the card, its priority and its shape are that seat's; ⛔ this project files no `domain:spec` card and edits no `scripts/` gate.
4. **PR 2 — `renderTemplate`, premise-bound.** Premise, falsifiable and measured before the branch is written: `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` exits 0 on a head whose changeset claims `runtime-export-retired @objectstack/plugin-email#renderTemplate` (the `85058b6e` diff for `plugin-email`, rebased, is the shape; same banner, declarations and FROM spelling; `requireVars`, `htmlToText`, `setTemplateLoader` stay). While it exits 1 the half is not written. ⛔ If the spec lane rules that a member signature is NOT a homonym, or declines the change, nobody falls back to C or D and nobody retires `renderTemplate` behind another category: the half returns to the box as a fresh fork with that ruling cited. Whoever holds the services lane then re-claims this card for PR 2 (a new `Claim:` naming its branch), same disposition, same review tier, dogfood battery owed again (bang title).
5. **Card state between the PRs.** When PR 1 lands, the landing stroke (three readings, strip `pm:dispatched`, clear the assignee, a `Release:` line) moves the card to `pm:blocked` with a line-initial `Blocked-by: #N` naming the spec lane's gate card if that card exists (the state machine's 「门禁卡」 target; ⛔ not a `Part of` tracker), else to `pm:on-hold` with `Restart-when: node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main exits 0 for the operand @objectstack/plugin-email#renderTemplate`, and `domain:services` seat 1 rewrites it to `pm:blocked` once the spec card's number is known. The card closes only when PR 2 lands.
6. ⛔ **Not:** `packages/spec`, `packages/lint`, `packages/formula`, `content/docs/**`, `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`, the plugin-email outlet pin test (PR #25212 holds it) — as the claim's surface already says.

### Why A, on the four axes (business standpoint)

- **① Long-term soundness (weight ≥50%).** Two years out there is one way a runtime export leaves a published package: the compiler-checked category, verified by a gate whose homonym test reads what TypeScript calls a declaration — including a member of a contract that happens to share a name with a function somewhere else. A keeps that one way for both halves and sends the reader's blind spot to its owner. C and D each add a second way that is false (a detector miss, or a ledger row that rewrites nothing). B keeps the one way but makes a maintainer-ruled 「at once」 wait on a lane with no date.
- **② Measured business pull.** Zero importers of either export from either package entry in this tree (tests included), zero in `objectstack-ai/hotcrm`, npm dependants unmeasured (the card's readings, re-grepped here on `cc8d886`: no `from '@objectstack/plugin-email'` or `'@objectstack/service-messaging'` import names them). No customer waits on either half; the pull is closing the door the placement rule cannot see (#25082), which `renderNotification` closes today and `renderTemplate` closes as soon as its disposition can be checked.
- **③ AI-error prevention.** Under A, a consumer meets `TS2305` at its own import with a FROM/TO line that names the stored-template door, for each half, under a category the gate re-verifies on every run. Under C the next retirement learns that an arrowless line is how to pass the gate — the quiet direction D9 closed. Under D an upgrading operator is told a migration exists where nothing is rewritten.
- **④ Startup no-sprawl.** Two PRs and one self-test case in an existing gate, no new mechanism, no new gate, no staged window. B is the same diff later; C and D are smaller today and a permanent misclassification.

Only-① pick: A. Do ②③④ flip it: no. Effort of the chosen letter: PR 1 `M`, `effort: high`, this card thread, no new slot; PR 2 the same when its premise holds; the spec-lane half is that lane's to size.
